inspected_anchors.finding: Title,authors,ACL2026 pages16403-16429,July2-7;18-model benchmark and code/data lead.
Four tasks and four robustness variants; answerability,process and causal-validity concepts are textual labels.
GPT5 generation,36 variants per seed,two manual rounds and entity substitution.
1200 seeds,43200 generated,10800 selected,8920 retained; unequal cell counts and ten annotators.
Table1 cell/task averages,near-ceiling OP and lower PJ/CVA; reported model scores are historical results.
AJ-PJ and VCR contrast diagnostics; negative challenge score for Grok4; task differences interpreted as causal-chain errors.
Explicit limitations on graph construction,structural rigor and counterfactual reasoning.
Few-shot and generation settings; Table3 Kappa values AJ.72/.78 and CVA.59-.65 contradict blanket excellent-agreement language.
Annotation category examples,reasoning prompt controls and filtering transition.
Remove incomplete,ambiguous and sensitive items; author claim competitor win discounts generator bias requires stronger evidence.
Entity-specific negative-response example and dual-prompt pass rates; qualitative mechanism explanation is not an identified causal diagnosis.
Checklist construction diagram maps four tasks and four robustness variants.
Example seed and altered contexts; textual context/answer requirements.
Final virtual-vocabulary causal-validity examples; supplied labels are adjudicated text tasks,not causal-effect estimates.

supported_claims: Framework crosses four task types with four robustness variants,using GPT5 transformations of CausalProbe seeds and manual checks.
Paper reports1200 seeds,43200 generated,10800 sampled and8920 retained; printed group counts sum to8920.
Table1 reports near-ceiling original-question accuracy with substantially lower process and causal-validity accuracy for selected models.
Challenge1 subtracts AJ and PJ marginal accuracies; challenge2 contrasts virtual-entity and real-entity task performance.
Table3 reports variable annotation agreement,including AJ.72/.78 and CVA.59-.65.
Authors acknowledge limited structural-graph and counterfactual evaluation; code/data and linked methodological references are separate leads.
limitations: Bounded author primary-text review; no complete frontier search or independent reproduction.
Publisher July2026 proceedings and June2026 PDF metadata precede cutoff; post-cutoff acquisition does not prove unchanged historical bytes.
Public code/data link is a lead; repository,raw item judgments,model snapshots and reuse rights are not qualified.
Textual benchmark accuracy and annotation agreement do not identify banking intervention effects.
No live model,downloaded code or upstream experiment executed; no rendered visual acceptance.

Paper count arithmetic checks printed entries only, not raw data, annotation or model execution.
Selection law and monetary values are hypothetical; no measured bank return.
